title: Lean 4 proofs for Erdős Problems 23 (n = 1 case; C5 blow-up tightness) and 1171 (colour monotonicity)
description: Kernel-checked Lean 4 / Mathlib proofs of three declarations from the formal-conjectures benchmark (google-deepmind/formal-conjectures): Erdos23.erdos_23.variants.n1, Erdos23.blowupC5_tight and Erdos1171.erdos_1171.variants.mono_k. These are a test case, the tightness example, and a monotonicity lemma. They do not resolve Erdős Problem 23 or 1171, which remain open. Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.
